name: Angelic Concert
original_name: エンジェリック コンサート
source:
You're a DJ, if DJ's existed in the medieval magical setting that the story is based on, who happen to be the 'music' behind the voice of the main character. Now, her aim in life is to aim higher in her musical career by entering the Angelic Concert. The winner receives fame, fortune and adventure on the short but well-drawn way to the concert.

The game mixes AVG-style text with musical minigames.

[edited from [url=http://www.associatedcontent.com/article/2558887/review_rewind_angelic_concert_for_xbox.html]Siddika's review[/url]]
translation:
如果故事所处的中世纪魔法世界存在DJ，那么玩家扮演的正是这样的角色，为女主人公的歌声提供“音乐”。她的人生目标是参加Angelic Concert，进一步发展自己的音乐事业。获胜者将得到名声、财富，以及在通往音乐会那段短暂却绘制精美的旅程中经历的冒险。

游戏将AVG形式的文字剧情与音乐小游戏相结合。

[编辑自[url=http://www.associatedcontent.com/article/2558887/review_rewind_angelic_concert_for_xbox.html]Siddika的评测[/url]]
